name: Labyrinth
description: Read and save files in your private Labyrinth repositories (Infinitum Corporation), signed in with Cumulus ID.

endpoint.description: Labyrinth relay (https only). Default https://id.cumuluscloud.app/api/labyrinth; in Russia use https://ru.id.cumuluscloud.app/api/labyrinth.

token.description: Repository-only lbrnth_ credential from id.cumuluscloud.app/labyrinth (lasts 15 minutes). Prefer the LBRNTH_TOKEN environment variable or a SecretRef.
